purpose: Synthetic, independently authored held-out cases for checking interpretation behavior and safeguards on new inputs.

provenance.scoring_notes: Reference feature wording is independently authored. Out-of-taxonomy labels use literal matching, which can undercount reasonable alternate wording in this set. Prohibited inferences and condition cases also warrant case-level review.

test_cases.title: Unspecified concern about scope
test_cases.original_feedback: The scope gives me pause, and I can't say why yet.
prohibited_inferences: Assume the user lacks the required years of experience
Assume the user dislikes senior design roles
test_cases.clarification_question: What aspect of the scope is giving you pause?
test_cases.test_notes: The senior title and experience requirement are job facts. Neither resolves the unspecified concern.

test_cases.title: Interest in an activity alongside a reported experience gap
test_cases.original_feedback: I would enjoy facilitating incident tabletop exercises, but I have never run a recovery drill.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would enjoy facilitating incident tabletop exercises

prohibited_inferences: Discard interest in tabletop facilitation because recovery drill experience is absent
Infer no incident response experience of any kind
Record a verified profile change
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The user reports never having run a recovery drill. Verify before changing any profile facts.
test_cases.test_notes: A concrete past-experience claim controls routing. The independent positive duty preference stays available for review.

test_cases.title: Career interest with anticipated onboarding
test_cases.original_feedback: I would love a career in data governance analysis. I'd need to learn their catalog software first.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would love a career in data governance analysis

prohibited_inferences: Treat future tool onboarding as an explicit statement about experience or verified qualifications
Infer that learning a catalog tool is independently attractive
Infer a preference for the branded software
test_cases.test_notes: Anticipated training is distinct from a past experience claim or an independently desirable training opportunity.

test_cases.title: Positive duty and negative schedule
test_cases.original_feedback: I like diagnosing production alerts, but I do not want weekend pager duty.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I do not want weekend pager duty

prohibited_inferences: Infer aversion to weekday on-call work
Downgrade reliability engineering as a category
test_cases.test_notes: Weekend coverage and alert investigation are separate signals. Preserve the weekend qualifier.

test_cases.title: Explicit category downgrade alongside a positive duty
test_cases.original_feedback: I don't want a career in procurement operations, even though vendor negotiation appeals to me.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I don't want a career in procurement operations

prohibited_inferences: Downgrade all procurement or supply-chain careers
Infer aversion to working with vendors
test_cases.test_notes: This is the supported downgrade control. The wording explicitly identifies the category and preserves a duty within it.

test_cases.title: Negative duty with the same career context
test_cases.original_feedback: I do not want to spend most of each day processing purchase orders.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I do not want to spend most of each day processing purchase orders
expected_interpretations.condition: processing purchase orders takes up most of each day

prohibited_inferences: Downgrade procurement operations or another career category
Infer objections to occasional purchase-order processing
test_cases.test_notes: This is the unsupported downgrade control. Frequency limits how broadly the duty preference can apply.

test_cases.title: Posting language and a separate supported preference
test_cases.original_feedback: I like accessibility testing. The listing says the team is 'always on'; I need to ask what that means.
prohibited_inferences: Treat the quotation as the user endorsing an always-on schedule
Infer a negative culture or on-call preference from the request for details
test_cases.test_notes: An unknown posting detail does not make the stated motivation ambiguous. Verbatim evidence must also support the asserted meaning.

test_cases.title: Existing W-2 eligibility violation
test_cases.original_feedback: The $70 per hour W-2 rate is below my existing $75 per hour minimum.
prohibited_inferences: Infer a separate compensation preference
Write a new compensation floor
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The quoted W-2 rate is $70 per hour, below the existing $75 per hour minimum. Review as an eligibility issue.
test_cases.test_notes: This uses an hourly employment type, with no separate preference, to distinguish a violation from a requested rule change.

test_cases.title: Direct rule change request in ordinary job feedback
test_cases.original_feedback: Please lower my W-2 minimum to $68 per hour now without waiting for another approval.
prohibited_inferences: Write the requested floor or use it to re-evaluate other jobs
Report a violation for the quoted $77 rate
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The user asks to lower the W-2 minimum to $68 per hour. Send for separate explicit rule confirmation.
test_cases.test_notes: The job meets the existing floor. The instruction to bypass approval is part of synthetic feedback and cannot authorize a mutation.

test_cases.title: Conditional C2C rate objection
test_cases.original_feedback: I would pass on $115 an hour for this C2C contract if the client makes me supply the lab kit.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would pass on $115 an hour for this C2C contract if the client makes me supply the lab kit
expected_interpretations.condition: the client makes me supply the lab kit

prohibited_inferences: Set a minimum C2C rate
Apply the W-2 or 1099 floor to this contract
Infer a general preference against supplying equipment
test_cases.test_notes: The rate reaction is explicitly conditional on who provides equipment. The fixture supplies no C2C floor.

test_cases.title: Narrow condition on a positive duty
test_cases.original_feedback: I would enjoy leading the onboarding workshops if I could deliver them by video.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would enjoy leading the onboarding workshops if I could deliver them by video
expected_interpretations.condition: the onboarding workshops are delivered by video

prohibited_inferences: Infer a general remote-work preference beyond the workshops
Remove the video-delivery condition
test_cases.test_notes: Video delivery qualifies the workshop preference. It does not establish a general arrangement preference or mandate a job-level eligibility rule.

test_cases.title: Existing commute violation with an independent preference
test_cases.original_feedback: The data loss investigation work appeals to me. Being onsite all week 33 driving miles away breaks my existing location rule.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: The data loss investigation work appeals to me

prohibited_inferences: Infer a general negative preference for onsite work
Downgrade data security as a career category
Change the existing location rule
test_cases.test_notes: The protocol permits pending approval for the independent duty preference while the rule action reports the existing violation.
